book.name: Hipru
book.title: Hipru Honi Tombaiva Geinna Hiprunindmba, Sesoava Ishovna Ombolnashara.

content: Yeoa Naongla Vrivm Yesusmoa, Wo Wohvivm.

Pimba best eva indhanamba nunglulavma, pimba doa pulningewol vina, wo himba pimba titihowol ovuv. Himba nomba temba doarava keknamba undnahonamba avnamba. Noinda hena wevsava eishunv pimba nom, osm, undnahonamba osm uv. Wo noinda pioa eva dandwonam angalohvra, no monaramoa, Sesoava pimba temba unnamba, alhmana velmba no monaramba, wo eva kivrawuliha vrivramoa. Wo noinda osva pioa wuleihalohra mana vemakoklava, temba pimba kekaiv vevpa, ata osva pivva dandwonamba angavavmoa. Wo pimba osva beswonam tingeswulvra pivna indkoklamba, nomba temba pimba kekaiv vevpa hengava.

Pioa ambo naongla vrelohra Yesusmangas. He pinamba keknamba undnahonamba almba sonovhueinna, wo himba pimba vinvna, osm keknam ara hevna velgona. Yesusva kinmba guana, krusera wikleihivnam. Wo heva os himba wohvravna louva krusesrava senamba louhui. Manara, himba nengna, ona, Sesoava si kamba indk vethalmba vraohvav sewonam. Wo daipotava himba Sesoana nihanasis king kuwulna vuheramsna av.

Ningminivm Yesusmangas. Himba nengnamoa nomba, nonamba indhanakoklava sahonamba indkoklawonamba hemba vinivnamba. Nunglivm Yesusna wevsam, osm yimba si nona keknamba avra, eva mana vemava yemba wiki vewol vevra.
Sesoava Snal, Oi Ara.
Yimba pevna indkoklamba wuleihalm viv. Noinda kava olhmomba olhv, osva yimba pevna indkoklamongo daos ohov. Heva os hona daosrava yenamba doava yemba mongova dahavmoa, osva tovolva pihavmoa.
Yimba doa maivethakovna Sesoa arana moamba, yemba suwenamandna vewol ovolmba,

content.text: Kana towand, manam yimba ningvav, osva mendeklina moamba, novnavhoramba velmba, ambo ombam, owai. Wo manam yimba wuleihivav, lehawuvulmba, nonamba Sesoava yemba sishona vewol vevpa.
Manara noinda mendekliva sishona vewol vev, nom hev ten keknam und vewol vevm. Wo himba bui vewol vev indkumbimba, nomba himba temba unvpa, hevtindilmba. Sindaun 3:11-12

content: Wohdumbvm pevna kinoa, os maim uvra, arahumunpev yem ten vinvram. Sesoa honamba manam manam vinv yemba, os oi, aral vinv hevna otovotalm. Otovotalmba hevna arahumunilva bui velahav.
Otovotalmba yunalm wohbui velahavm. Yemba bui vewolalmba owai vetava, yimba besalva tanamba otovotalva owai, yimba maim oi, timingrini.

Pivva huiva petharava avpa, ararangas he pimba bui velahav. Wo pimba pivna aramba beswonam longong vewol viv. Wo noinda osva memba mendekli, nomba buimba pimba vralmba pivna aranamba senaminirininamba. Pimba honamba osva vellava, pimba si osva undna avav.

Pina arahumunmba honamba pethariniva bui vewol viv pimba, nonam piv eusil mendah ahalvm. Himba pimba nona bui vewol viv, hev ten os ningvm, memba besal honamba. Wo heva os Sesoava pimba bui vewol vevpa, pim kolvrowolalm, osm pimba osva avav helmangas besalangas, os hev ten avm.
Pimba und vivmoa buimba. Buiramba lilmba nihsesoa vev. Wo heva os sewonamba sismba pimba sungeipilalga vevra buiriniva, pivva avav beswonam, manara, pimba doa kovohlavra, beswonam alm besal monam.
Vivm Novnavhora, Es Yimba Av.
Buiramba lilmba besal, manara, monglava yemba doa oi vehawol vena. Keknam kel wosapro pevna henga.
Wo avm besalmonam, osm yemba si lopshawol vevav, wo oiva nomba yenamba si yemba kekaiv vevavmoa, owolakovolmba.
Lihvm, beswonamangasm alm indkumbimongom, wo eva viu, lihvm, alm Sesoalmangas. Henomba Sesoalmangasva beswonamba lohmba owai vevrava, himba si owaimomolmba nonglavavmoa mendeklimba.
Pevmoa novnavhora vivm, ata mongo indkokla vevra, wo noinda himba Sesoana wavrava ata homeis nengvramoa. Indhanariniva lohollava snamba, himba si yemba monglamba wohindkokla vewol vevav.

Novnavhora vivm, ata anvema nihtov kovopethavav ongariskuira. Novnavhora vivm, ata mongo ora vevai, os ten Esau nemet venam, os Sesoamba nengmanavnamoa. Esauva etel, wo manimani he vaohothovav hevna aralnamba. Wo heva os Esauva hevna boasalalm Yakopm omnana, ye daha pivna aranapuwuloa vaohotho, kava owai. Wo Yakoppa hemba no nungnam inne dembrahona, nonam nelm mongawulm.

Yimba nonora av nom, osm sismba Esauva honamba vena, himba nengvna, dombolm aranapuwulm. Himba nengvna honamba mindnam, wo wovevna, noinda himba os nengloh venamba, nom weihaloh vrelm, hev ten venam, heva os owai.
Pimba Indkumbiva Sesoana Yivaltowondmsna Av.

Pimba senakembellam angav, Sainai oloramba owai, osva temba pina tomonalva vinamba nemetva. Yimba vonganamoa oloramba, osmba yimba pevna englana tuhvav, wo nomba yunam suwe telahavna. Yimba doava sikulmerava saivnamoa, temba wohkilvralohvpa, eva vuvi mendeklirava. Pina tomonalna wevsa, himba os pulvona Sainai olorava, Sesoamba hellelmba. Heva os pimba owai daipotava.

Himba vuvm hillivna Sesoanam. Nonamba himba hillivnamba weitva, himba nonakulm wohhillivna Sesoana moalamangmba, wo himba pemba os vivna, i. Hev Mosesm umnina, es, Sesoam os omno, kava hellelmba vivmoa hemba.
Himba ningvnamoa, moamba nomba hellelmba. Osva indhanariniva tuhvrava olomba, hem nomoa wohmiklivm honnangas, eva tatamba osoa osta.
Mana vemamba himba temba nunglinamba, sahoklalnonoa, os Mosesva ona, kava pem venamba, kamba woheisna.

Wo heva os yimba ambvmoa sna olorava. Nemel olomba memba yimba ambvpa, olo Saion. Yimba doa ambv Sesoana mendeklikembel Yerusalem, di dihelv senakembella, Sesoava ten noi yunalm wohavm. Yimba dom ambv, di 1,000pelara ovsongolnind kusovnam mongawulm indwonamangas.

Yimba doa eksuwulprana Sesoana yivaltowondna moaramba. Hena nonamba nihilva di novol veluhunv senakembella. Yimba doa ambna, domba temba Sesoava no vuherava lesvhoawol vawovpa indkumbimba. Wo ye vena, doa ambna besal indhana songoramba, hem ten Sesoa doa lesvhoawol venam, unna, yimba indhana windel. Wo noinda doa himba beswonam av.

Manara, yimba doa pepavena nihra Yesusinda, henoi ten nemelmoa wulprunnam Sesoanamini hevtindim. Yimba doa saivna Yesusna tovol velanglallava, wo no tovolmerava Sesoava moamba besal ishunv pimba, wavramom. Snamba owai, temba Sesoava Apelna tovolmerava ishunnamba, esesmba.
Pioa Sesoana Das Owolmomoa Hellellohra.

Wo doa novnavhora vivm, manam yimba aongva nukun vewol vivra, nonamba Sesoava ishovrava. Tomonalva kongswul vevna, hellelmba hemba, nonamba Sesoava hemba ongawolvnamba petharava. Wo Sesoava kinmba plothunna hemba. Daipotava Sesoava ongawolvna pimba senamini. Osrava mana vema si pimba ongolohvav, pivva aongva nukun vewol vitava, pimba si esvema vinvra kinmba.
Nemetva nonamba himba ishovnamba, hena moarava pethava daihavna. Wo heva os daipotava himba doa moamba ishona,

content.text: Henga kava si vevav, osva pethamangasmba owai, daihavavmoa, ovnahonam daihara. Hagai 2:6

content: Hona moamba henga pimba novpa wuleihinv, nomba manam manam temba venamba, si daihaprarava, wo hoai vilovav. Osra manimani nomba si daihapramba owai vellava, nongas si wohlohvav beswonamba. Manara, Sesoa hev kekaiv viav.

Wo noinda osva pioa olohmanara, os, yimba lehra, manara noinda pimba si wohavav Sesoana nemeltindirava, osm noindava indkokla vilovavmoa, hoai vilovavmoa. Pioa sembayang vewuvmona velohmanara Sesoamoa, no monana himba ambo und kanandhavra. Pioa hemoa okolalohra longongnahonam pepehnahonam.
Manara noinda pivna Sesoava snal av, maim oi, suwe tav, noi ten manam manam wohtelahavm.
